We apply <a class="site-q" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.19457">GEPA</a> around those weights but through symbolic programs that writes the layers and weights of a network. The motivation is to undertand that whether pareto based search could perform better than one-shot weight-space programming or an Adam optimiser to optimise a neural network. The code is available <a class="site-q" href="https://github.com/devichand579/gepa_wsp">here</a>.</p> <p>A candidate is a program, <code>edit(w, f)</code>. It can read the training arrays, the current weights, forward activations, and simple statistics, and it can fit a closed-form model but could not apply a parameter gradient or a Newton update. Validation inputs, labels, and traces stay out of the program and out of the reflection. A candidate is accepted when every parameter keeps its key, shape, and float32 type, every value is finite, and no magnitude exceeds a pre-defined threshold. A program that fails those checks leaves the current weights unchanged. GEPA then scores the frozen network on the validation slice and chooses the next parent from the Pareto set. Classification tasks keeps the candidate with the higher accuracy and diffusion keeps the candidate with the lower noise-prediction error. <p>Three reasoning models were used.     svg += `<path d="M${p.l} ${y(baseline)}H${W-p.r}" fill="none" stroke="${COL.muted}" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="5 5"/><text x="${W-p.r}" y="${y(baseline)-7}" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="${COL.muted}" font-family="${COL.font}">Adam ${baseline.toFixed(3)}</text>`;
    [0,10,20,30,60].forEach(b => { svg += `<text x="${x(b)}" y="${H-p.b+18}" text-anchor="middle" font-family="${COL.font}" font-size="11" fill="${COL.muted}">${b}</text>`; });
    svg += `</svg>`;
    $("diffusion-chart").innerHTML = svg;
  }

  wireButtons("data-budget-task", task => { budgetTask = task; drawBudget(); });
  wireButtons("data-compare-task", task => { compareTask = task; animateCharts = !matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches; drawCompare(); animateCharts = false; });
  drawBudget();
  drawCompare();
  drawDiffusion();
  animateCharts = false;
  new MutationObserver(() => {
    animateCharts = !matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    drawBudget();
    drawCompare();
    drawDiffusion();
    animateCharts = false;
  }).observe(document.documentElement, {attributes:true, attributeFilter:["data-theme"]});
})();
